name: qp-outreach-engine
description: Infraestructura Centralizada de Prospección B2B, Scraping y WhatsApp Gateway Headless para The Quant Partners

scripts.build: tsc && node -e "const fs=require('fs'), path=require('path'); const src=path.resolve('src/master/blueprints'), dest=path.resolve('dist/master/blueprints'); if(fs.existsSync(src)){ fs.mkdirSync(dest, {recursive:true}); fs.readdirSync(src).forEach(f => fs.copyFileSync(path.join(src,f), path.join(dest,f))); }"

author: The Quant Partners (Kenneth & Smith)
